en: • HGUC Full Armor Unicorn GUNDAM As a final battle specification, it is now available in Destroy mode.
• The Psycho Frame is reproduced in clear green drawn in the Episode 7 key visual.
• Comes with a pedestal for displaying shields and beam Gatling guns.
• Comes with an additional mounting frame for setting Hyper Bazouga and large boosters in the backpack. Molded product ×16, foil seal ×1, assembly instruction ×1
